audit.why: EVEN at 6/10 fits 51.29% over 1123 games — hers for three levels, even through 6, Gangplank's after Sheen.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Gangplank level 1 and Riven both item stages, against the entry's own prose — 'Levels 1-3 are hers and you know it' and 'Once your first item lands... the lane tilts your way for good'.
audit.why: Riven's Broken Wings chain plus a free auto on a low-HP keg wins the first three levels; a Sheen-empowered Parrrley into a chained detonation out-bursts her combo from first item on and her flat scaling falls off.
audit.corrected: One group: L1 Riven 3/10, L2 Riven 3/10, L3 Skill 5/10, L4-5 Skill 5/10, L6 Skill 5/10, First item Gangplank 7/10, 2+ items Gangplank 8/10.
sources: currentText.early, whys[2], whys[3], whys[4], whys[5], whys[6]

audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings say to cleanse Ki Burst 'with Q'. Gangplank's Q is Parrrley, a ranged shot — the cleanse is Remove Scurvy (W), 22/20/18/16/14. No cooldowns are given for Ki Burst (11/10/9/8/7) or Broken Wings (13s). Valor's shield is never mentioned as a reason to time the detonation.
audit.why: Riot text: Gangplank W 'Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health'; Q only 'Shoots target'. Riven E 'steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage' — if she E's in and you detonate immediately, the shield eats the burst, so the keg should land after Valor is spent.
audit.corrected: Cleanse reassigned to Remove Scurvy (W) in all three strings; Ki Burst given 11s; the Valor shield made the timing rule for detonations.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization prescribes early anti-heal 'because his healing fights your pattern'. Riven has no healing anywhere in her kit.
audit.why: Riot's Riven kit: passive charges her blade, Q dashes, W stuns, E shields, R grants AD and range. Nothing heals. Buying Oblivion Orb early here spends 800+ gold against an ability that does not exist and delays the Sheen spike the entry itself calls the flip point.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal line replaced with the Valor shield timing rule; boots and core unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer calls Riven 'he' and 'him' throughout.
audit.why: Riven is female; the content layer uses 'she'.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected in the trade lines, do's, don'ts and trading report.
